The '''Imperial Maritime Division''',<ref name="IHB" /> also referred to as the '''Imperial Navy'''<ref name="Prima" /> (not to be confused with the Imperial Starfleet), was part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|Military]] that carried out operations on bodies of [[Water/Legends|water]] of different [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. It was one of the important organizational distinctions of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]], the ground forces of the Imperial Military.<ref name="IHB" /> The Navy's most notable actions were fighting in the [[Reytha campaign|battle]] for the [[Montrosa Islands]] and the [[Liberation of Kashyyyk/Legends|Liberation of Kashyyyk]].

==Functions==
It operated on oceans, rivers and urban waterways. When undergoing various missions, it utilized specialized aquatic vehicles, including destroyers, submersibles, and waveskimmers.<ref name="GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>

==History==
In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the Imperial Navy fought against [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Alliance Military/Legends|Alliance Military]] forces in the [[Reytha campaign|battle]] for the [[Montrosa Islands]] on the agricultural [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Reytha]] as part of a force led by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. The Navy engaged other [[Rebel Navy (aquatic)|Rebel Navy]] units for control of the [[Montrosa Ocean]] and supported the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] operations in that battle. [[Standard year/Legends|Years]] later, after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], naval units also fought against [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] forces while trying to defend communication [[Jammer/Legends|jammers]] during the [[Liberation of Kashyyyk/Legends|Liberation of Kashyyyk]], though the Imperials were ultimately defeated in the battle.

==Organization==
The Imperial Navy undertook aquatic operations for the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]]. Its [[Shipyard (water)|bases]] were constructed by [[ASP-7 labor droid/Legends|ASP-7 labor droids]] and [[utility trawler]]s gathered resources such as food from aquaharvesters. The Navy used [[Shipyard (water)|shipyards]] to construct a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of vehicles such as [[Scout (Galactic Empire)|frigates]], [[Destroyer (Galactic Empire)|destroyers]], [[Transport Ship (Galactic Empire)|transports]], and [[Missile Destroyer (Galactic Empire)|anti-air destroyers]].<ref name="GB" /> Although the Navy was powerful in its own right, it was also one of the weaker elements of the Imperial Military overall.<ref name="Prima" />

==Ship classes==
===Scout frigates===
Within the Imperial Navy, there were aquatic scout frigates, repulsorlift craft sent to scout ahead on water or escort heavier vessels. Light Scouts were the most basic variant, armed with a captain and at least one gunner. The [[Scout (Galactic Empire)|Standard Scouts]] succeeded the Light Scouts, and were built with a sleeker cockpit. Heavier-armed variants known as the Advanced Scouts.<ref name="GB" />

===Destroyers===
The Imperial Navy also made use of various aquatic repulsorlift destroyers. The [[Destroyer (Galactic Empire)|standard Destroyer]] was clam-shelled in shape, and carried one pummel. The heavy variant was largely similar to the standard Destroyer, only with one additional pummel. Both variants were utilized by Darth Vader during the [[Reytha campaign]] of the Galactic Civil War.<ref name="GB" />

===Cruiser===
Likewise, the Imperial Navy made use of various aquatic repulsorlift cruisers. The [[Cruiser (Galactic Empire)|standard Cruiser]] was boat-shaped with a single laser cannon. The heavy variant was largely similar, but possessed two laser cannon turrets and heavier armor.<ref name="GB" />

===Anti-Air defense ships===
The Imperial Navy also made use of Anti-Air defense ships, colloquially known as Missile Destroyers due to their common weapon choice, anti-air missiles. The [[Missile Destroyer (Galactic Empire)|standard Missile Destroyers]] had thick armored hulls and a single anti-air missile launcher. The Heavy variant possessed heavier armor and two anti-air launchers. Both variants were utilized by Darth Vader during the Reytha Campaign of the Galactic Civil War.<ref name="GB" />

===Other===
In addition to the vessels in the Imperial Navy directly related to combat, various vessel also served additional purposes. The [[Transport Ship (Galactic Empire)|Transport Ships]] were utilized to transport various ground personnel and vehicles to various locations on a planet via water, and were boxy/rectangular in shape. They served during the Reytha Campaign in 0 ABY. [[Utility trawler]]s were also used by the Galactic Empire to supply their various bases with fish and other aquaculture harvesting, with their models specifically resembling tanker ships of old.<ref name="GB" /> The [[Imperial submarine/Legends|Imperial submarines]] were vessels that could submerge underwater and are capable of firing torpedoes at enemy fighters. Several were used during the [[Battle of Dubrillion (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Dubrillion]] against [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], when the Rebel squadron attempted to destroy a [[Dubrillion superlaser facility|superlaser test bed]] that caught their fleet by surprise. [[Explorer Submergible]]s served a similar purpose, although it was meant for exploration and assault, possessing heavy weaponry to take out hostile lifeforms. [[Amphibion]]s were also utilized as early as the [[Battle of Corellia (1 ABY)|Battle of Corellia]] up to before the revelation of the [[Dark Empire]]. The Imperial Navy also had manufactured starfighters that were specifically capable of operating underwater, including the [[TIE fighter boat]] and, under the Krayt Empire, the [[Shark underwater fighter]]. They also utilized the [[Aquadon CAVa 400]]s, modified versions of the [[Compact Assault Vehicle/Wheeled PX-10|CAVw PX-10s]] for aquatic sieges. [[Waveskimmer/Legends|Waveskimmers]] such as the single person ones and the AT-AT derived [[AQ-5 Waveskimmer]]s.

During the Krayt Empire and Fel Empires, the Imperial Navy also utilized the [[Acklay-class mobile fortress|''Acklay''-class mobile fortress]].

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|'The Empire is not so strong in sea or air,' adds Keast. This makes sense.|Keast and Hollander commentary|<ref name="Prima" />}}
The aquatic Imperial Navy was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]] for the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'', although was not mentioned by name in the game itself. Players get the opportunity to build Imperial Navy units in one of the Darth Vader campaign missions, and face computer-controlled units in one of the Chewbacca campaign missions. The missions and therefore the Navy appear in the game's [[2002]] expansion pack, [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|''Clone Campaigns'']]. The vehicles may also be constructed in multiplayer matches by Imperial players.

In Chapter 5 of the strategy guide, one of the members of ''Galactic Battleground''{{'s}} creative team, [[Matthew Keast]], implied that the Empire was at a disadvantage regarding sea-based operations.

The branch was later given the name of the Imperial Maritime Division in the ''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'', as well as identified as being a branch of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].
